description: Read the saved transcription glossary of this account (or key): correct spellings with their aliases (what speech-to-text writes instead) and do-not-translate terms. Free, read-only; needs a key. Every transcribe and translate applies it automatically, so read it to check why a word came out as it did. Change it with update_glossary {action:'save'} or update_glossary {action:'delete'}.

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.

name: get_glossary
title: Get saved glossary
